information: We are pleased to announce that the 2026 North American Championship will take place in Raleigh, North Carolina! This competition will serve as both the US National Championship and the North American Championship. Please note that **all spectators must have a spectator ticket**. Competitors will receive one free spectator ticket as part of their registration. Additional tickets can be purchased on [Ticketor](http://ticketor.com/cubingusa); limited quantities are available so make sure to purchase your spectator tickets early! All events have qualifying times; please refer to the [CubingUSA site](https://cubingusa.org/nac/2026/qualifying) for full details.
